news.headline: Argus Lowers IES Holdings Price Target to $275
news.summary: Argus trimmed its price target on IES Holdings to $275, still well above the share price, which traded in the $210-$230 range in late October. The cut came as data-center-exposed contractors had already pulled back from their highs.

news.headline: IES Holdings Ups Borrowing Capacity to $700 Million With Wells Fargo-Led Amended Credit Facility
news.summary: The amended credit agreement raises total capacity to $700 million, split into a $200 million term loan and a $500 million revolver. IES drew $525 million under the facility to fund the DBM Global purchase, so the company moves from a net-cash position to carrying meaningful debt.

news.headline: IES Holdings Completes Acquisition of DBM Global
news.summary: IES closed the purchase of steel fabricator and erector DBM Global from INNOVATE for about $691 million, paid with roughly $545 million in cash and 430,974 IES shares. DBM, with about $1.5 billion of trailing revenue to June 30, 2026, becomes a new Structural segment.

news.headline: Director Todd Cleveland Reports 80,000 Trust Shares and 12,000 IRA Shares in IES Holdings
news.summary: A Form 4 filing shows director Todd M. Cleveland reporting 80,000 shares held in a trust and 12,000 in an IRA. The filing documents his holdings; it is not clear from the summary whether these were open-market purchases.

news.headline: IES Holdings: Best House On A Shaky Street
news.summary: A Seeking Alpha analysis argues IES is one of the strongest operators among electrical and data-center contractors, while warning that the broader group trades on stretched expectations. The piece frames the key risk as sector sentiment rather than company execution.

catalysts.label: Fiscal Q4 and full-year 2026 results
catalysts.detail: IES's fiscal year ended September 30. Last year it reported on November 21, so a report around November 20 is expected but not yet scheduled. Investors will focus on data-center demand and backlog after the post-election sell-off, and on any early comments on DBM Global, which closed after quarter-end.

catalysts.label: Fiscal Q1 2027 results, first quarter including DBM Global
catalysts.detail: The December-quarter report, typically released in early February, will be the first to consolidate DBM Global as the new Structural segment. It will show the combined revenue base, acquisition-related margin effects and the leverage from the $525 million drawn on the credit facility.

pulse: As of November 6, 2026, IESC has fallen sharply, from about $224 on October 29 to $145.58 on November 5, including drops of about 17% on November 4 and 14% on November 5. The fall came as data-center builders sold off after the Democratic midterm sweep and the Texas governor-elect's call for a data-center construction pause; no company-specific bad news was reported. The business has just been transformed by the October 5 closing of the roughly $691 million DBM Global acquisition, which adds about $1.5 billion of structural-steel revenue, funded largely with $525 million drawn on an expanded $700 million credit facility. The fiscal Q4 report, expected around November 20, is the next test of whether data-center backlog is holding up.
